title: Canonical intrinsic realization of the compact-support scalar mate
statement: For finite commutative rings A and B, a ring homomorphism phi:A -> B, a compactification c with noetherian proper source and target, a bounded-below etale A-complex G and a bounded-below etale B-complex GB identified with its actual derived scalar extension, the specified intrinsic compact-support scalar-adjunction transpose on the comparison pullback of G equals the explicitly constructed intrinsicCompactScalarIsoOfOrigin. The latter is the etale proper scalar mate composed with the open scalar isomorphism, transported through the canonical site and intrinsic realization comparisons. This records equality of the specific maps, not merely equality of their endpoints. The auxiliary definitions construct every comparison explicitly from recorded adjunctions and normalized comparisons.

source.place: Steps 7--10: scalar-mate transport through comparison inverse image and intrinsic realization; Stacks 0GL6, 09AL and 0D6J

proof.text: Construct openScalarIso by uniqueness of the left adjoints of the coefficient/open restriction square. Compose it with the proper finite-coefficient scalar mate, which is invertible on noetherian schemes, to construct compactScalarIso. Construct realizationScalarIso by adjoint uniqueness from the sectionwise normalized inverse realization/restriction square, and compose it with the canonical site/scalar comparison.

Construct compactRealizationIso by the realization equivalence unit and the normalized derived direct-image comparison. Compose it with the canonical compact-support site comparison and the scalar comparison to obtain intrinsicCompactScalarIsoOfOrigin; the intermediate GB is used with its actual identification, and its arbitrary isomorphism cancels by naturality.

Factor compactSiteIso into properSiteIso at the bounded-below open extension and proper image of openSiteIso. This follows by expanding the canonical D+ comparison and canceling the inclusion and realization isomorphisms.

Apply openScalar_transport to G, GB and eGB. It supplies the open scalar square. Apply properScalar_transport to their exact open extensions H and HB, with eH equal to openScalarIso followed by open extension of eGB. It supplies the proper scalar square. Adjunction naturality factors the compact scalar transpose, and naturality of the proper transpose past openSiteIso pastes the two squares. The resulting composite is the explicit compact scalar isomorphism after applying the site/scalar identification and eGB at the source. Cancel that isomorphism to obtain the stated equality.

lean.statement:
theorem intrinsicCompactScalarIsoOfOrigin_hom
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f)
    [IsNoetherian c.Z] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (G : DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A))))
    (GB : DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} B))))
    (eGB : (Etale.scalarExtension (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1, u, u} φ) X).obj G.obj ≅
      GB.obj) :
    ((pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction (scalarRingMap φ Y)).homEquiv _ _).symm
      ((sfIntrinsicCompactSupport c A).map
          ((pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction (scalarRingMap φ X)).unit.app
            ((ProEtale.finiteCoefficientIntrinsicDerivedComparison X A).obj G.obj)) ≫
        (sfCompactSupportRestriction c φ).hom.app
          ((pbcDerivedExtend (scalarRingMap φ X)).obj
            ((ProEtale.finiteCoefficientIntrinsicDerivedComparison X A).obj G.obj))) =
      (intrinsicCompactScalarIsoOfOrigin φ c G GB eGB).hom
